sourceDecisionCards.decision: Use Companies / Mandanten -> Neu dropdown -> Neues Unternehmen erstellen as the official route gate.

sourceBasis.source: Microsoft Learn: Create new companies in Business Central
sourceBasis.relevantClaim: The Create New Company assisted setup guide is available from the Companies page and from the Company field lookup in My Settings.
Production - Setup Data Only creates setup data without sample data; Create New - No Data creates a blank company.

rejectedAlternatives: Kopieren / Copy because it uses an existing company as basis.
Testunternehmen / demo / sample data because Universaarl must not inherit demo master data.
Direct unsaved list row save until BC UI proves the row fields and save behavior clearly.
API shortcut because the book needs a UI-first click path.
sourceDecisionCards.selectedRoute: Open the wizard route only. Do not click Next, Finish, Create, OK or Save until field mapping and data basis are visible and documented.
sourceDecisionCards.risk: The wizard might offer an unsafe copy/demo route or a finish button before the data basis is understood.
sourceDecisionCards.stopRule: Stop after the wizard/context screenshot. If any error, dialog or unclear route appears, write blocker evidence and do not create a company.
